rules.contract: Every field of the record's format appears exactly once; unknown, duplicate, and missing fields fail closed. FORMAT=1 omits MOUNT_SSH and must not contain it.
State is parsed as KEY=VALUE data and is never sourced or evaluated.
Writers emit FORMAT=2. Readers accept FORMAT=2 and FORMAT=1, reading each absent field at its listed default; future formats fail closed.
Recorded paths are adapter-native, absolute, normalized, control-free, and constrained to their recorded roles.
Install, runtime-resource, image, source, and numeric host identities use their closed lexical forms.
BUILD, EDGE, HOME_VOLUME_ADOPTED, and MOUNT_SSH are 0 or 1, and EDGE requires BUILD.
Stable, prerelease, legacy, edge, and source-build fields form one coherent source and image identity.
Field names and shared constraints match across adapters, while path/profile values remain adapter-native and creator-owned.
